description: Get one Durability Curve essay: by default its full public text as markdown, with its title, dates, canonical field, access, length, sections, tools and a link to its claim ledger when it has one. A long essay can be read in parts: part "outline" lists the sections with their opening lines, part "section" returns one, and part "meta" returns everything but the text. For a part-paid essay only the free part is public, and the text says where it stops. The canonical field is the address to cite. These tools retrieve The Durability Curve's public material. They do not certify that any claim is true.

part.description: full (default): the whole public text. meta: dates, length, access, sections, tools and a content hash, without the text. outline: each section's heading, length and opening lines. section: one section's text (name it with section).

section.description: With part "section": the section's number from the outline (0 is the opening, before the first heading) or words from its heading.

slug.description: The essay's site or Substack slug (case-insensitive), or its full durabilitycurve.com/blog/ or harryfloyd.substack.com/p/ URL.

name: get_essay
title: Get an essay
